prompt:
A blank, empty trading-card frame template for a card game based on ancient Egyptian myth and the Book of the Dead, seen perfectly flat and straight-on, filling the whole image edge to edge, portrait orientation. Layout from top to bottom: a narrow horizontal title bar across the top with a round empty medallion at its right end; below it a large rectangular art window taking up about the upper half of the card, filled with solid flat pure black (#000000) with crisp straight edges; below that a thin horizontal type bar; below that a large empty rectangular text box of pale aged parchment; at the bottom right a small empty plaque overlapping the corner of the text box. The title bar, medallion, type bar, text box and plaque are completely blank. Style: a rustic, retro 1990s hand-painted trading-card frame, gouache and ink texture, worn and weathered like an old printed card, muted colours, matte with no glossy highlights, no glow, no light rays, no sky, symmetrical with clean edges. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no logo, no watermark, and nothing inside the black window.

Legendary rarity, the grandest frame of all, made almost entirely of radiant burnished gold, like the golden shrine and mask of Tutankhamun: thick sculpted gold borders glowing with warm light, the great golden outspread wings of the sacred ibis of Thoth sweeping all the way down both sides, every feather of beaten gold with thin inlays of lapis and turquoise; at the top centre a large glowing silver moon disc in a golden crescent, sending out golden rays; gold cobras and gold lotus flowers, jewels of carnelian and lapis set into the corners, a band of gold stars on deep lapis along the top, and gold hieroglyph-like ornament (no readable signs) along the bottom. It shines like treasure in torchlight. Hand-painted, never glossy or 3D-rendered. Ancient Egyptian look, New Kingdom, like Egyptian temple and tomb painting and the jewellery of Tutankhamun: lapis lazuli blue, turquoise and faience green, carnelian and red ochre, gold leaf, black and limestone white; lotus and papyrus friezes, block borders of coloured bars, winged sun discs, decorative pattern bands with no readable hieroglyphs. No Greek, Norse or Chinese elements.
Near-mint condition: aged and antique, but no play wear, creases or scuffs. The wear is on the frame only; the black art window stays solid, untouched black.
